above_basis: The Austronesian levels TLOPO reconstructs above Oceanic, placed as the ACD's tree places them (Blust's subgrouping, which TLOPO's introduction follows): PAn > PMP > {PWMP, PCEMP > {PCMP, PEMP > {PSHWNG, Oceanic}}}.

protocenderawasihbay.basis: Cenderawasih Bay is a South Halmahera-West New Guinea group.

pss.basis: TLOPO's PSS joins Northwest and Southeast Solomonic forms (its note), which meet only at Proto Oceanic in its tree.

protocentralpapuan.basis: Central Papuan is a Papuan Tip group.

pcepn.basis: Central Eastern Polynesian is an Eastern Polynesian group.

prototahitic.basis: Tahitic is a Central Eastern Polynesian group.

protosamoic.basis: Samoic is a Nuclear Polynesian group.

protosolomonsoutlier.basis: The Solomons Polynesian Outliers are Nuclear Polynesian.

protosouthmelanesian.basis: Southern Melanesian (South Vanuatu and New Caledonia) is a Nuclear Southern Oceanic group.

protosefatesv.basis: South Efate and South Vanuatu meet in Nuclear Southern Oceanic.

protoerakortafea.basis: Erakor (South Efate) with the Tafea (South Vanuatu) languages.

protohotebuang.basis: Hote-Buang is a Huon Gulf group.

protofarnorthnewcaledonia.basis: Far North New Caledonian is a North New Caledonian group.
